_comment: Extracted from amanda.Correction.open.v9 RESOLVED-LEDGER + amanda.State.v18 archive narrative. Real shape: every retired schema has a retire_ts, falsifier_met text, and a V2_verifier_window during which it cannot reappear in active state. The 'ARMED-until' date is the door; before it, resurrection requires a new locked falsifier.
